subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a WhatsApp/channel heartbeat recipient config for OK acknowledgments, and what field shape, precedence, and allowlist validation should it use?
rationale: The gap is real, but solving it adds public config surface and recipient-routing semantics that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add OK-recipient config
options.body: Add a maintainer-defined `target`/`targets`-style contract that applies only to visible OK acknowledgments and validates recipients through WhatsApp account policy.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Keep the current `showOk`/`showAlerts` plus agent-level heartbeat target model and tell users to disable OK visibility or route the whole heartbeat to an admin destination.

options.title: Defer for generalized channel routing
options.body: Hold this issue until a broader channel heartbeat recipient model can cover WhatsApp and other channels consistently.

recommendation.title: Add OK-recipient config
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-defined `target`/`targets`-style contract that applies only to visible OK acknowledgments and validates recipients through WhatsApp account policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history in the config/outbound routing area and already participated in the issue's prior review discussion.
